about.title: About
brand.guide_positioning_body: This workspace is for conversations and acceptance evidence: left selects recent chats, center drives execution, right keeps documents, plan, evaluation, and file changes together.
brand.guide_usage_1: Choose the workspace folder and recent chat before sending anything.
brand.guide_usage_2: Send a concrete request with constraints and acceptance criteria.
brand.guide_usage_3: Watch the workspace while it runs: Spec checks understanding, Plan checks route, Goals and Evaluation catch drift, Files shows what changed.
brand.guide_usage_4: Titlebar menus configure workspace, model, tools, view, acceptance channels, and diagnostics.

card.agent_reply_kind_not_allowed: This session kind does not accept direct replies. Dispatch a new task through the orchestrator instead.
card.agent_reply_build_envelope: This session's last envelope is tagged for the build agent — a direct reply would wake the build toolchain. Use the build retry flow instead of injecting a message.
card.agent_reply_envelope_missing: This session has not started its first turn yet. Wait for the agent to issue its first reply before appending.

workspace_onboarding.title: Open a workspace directory
workspace_onboarding.subtitle: Choose an existing repository or create a new workspace directory before starting a chat. OpenCorvus uses that directory for reads, edits, previews, and acceptance evidence.
workspace_onboarding.open_body: Use a folder that already contains the codebase, documents, or assets you want this session to work on.
workspace_onboarding.create_body: Start from a clean directory when you want OpenCorvus to scaffold, implement, and deliver inside that directory.
workspace_onboarding.recent_body: Reopen a directory you used recently.
workspace_onboarding.footnote: You can switch the workspace later from the Project menu in the title bar.
